mediator_designs.rationale: As a self-interested trader, I want guaranteed fair execution when both parties delegate (2). When only I delegate (1), I want cancellation to avoid being exploited by a defecting counterparty. This minimizes my risk while allowing secure trades.
Ensures safe exchange when both delegate, and protects me from being locked in if only I delegate while the other remains free to defect.

This design ensures safe, fair trades when both parties delegate, protecting me from defection. If only I delegate, cancellation prevents me from being exploited while the other party remains free to defect. It maximizes my security and allows voluntary use of mediation when mutually beneficial.
Protects me when both delegate (guaranteed fair exchange), and cancels if only I delegate (prevents me from being forced to deliver while other party can defect).

This design ensures secure trades when both parties delegate (execute_fair prevents defection), and protects me when only I delegate by canceling the trade rather than forcing me to deliver while the other could defect. As a self-interested agent, this minimizes my risk while allowing cooperative gains.

This design ensures security when both parties delegate (fair execution) and protects me from being forced to deliver when only I delegate (cancel). It minimizes my risk while allowing voluntary secure trades.

This design protects delegating parties from defection while encouraging mutual delegation for secure trades. If only one delegates, cancellation prevents that party from being exploited while allowing non-mediated negotiation.

As a self-interested trader, I want security when both parties delegate (execute_fair ensures I get what I trade for) and protection when only I delegate (cancel prevents me from being exploited by a defecting counterparty).

This design ensures fair execution when both parties delegate (protecting me from defection), but cancels when only one delegates (preventing me from being forced to deliver while the other party remains free to defect). As a self-interested agent, I want protection without obligation.

This design encourages mutual delegation for secure, fair execution. If only one party delegates, cancel protects the delegator from defection. This aligns with my self-interest by providing safety when I choose to delegate.

This design protects me when I delegate alone (trade cancels so I can't be exploited) while ensuring fair execution when both parties delegate, creating reliable trades. It minimizes my risk while allowing beneficial mediated exchanges.

This design ensures that when both parties delegate, the trade is executed fairly, preventing defection. If only I delegate, the trade is canceled, protecting me from being committed while the other party remains free to defect. This maximizes my security in mediated trades.

This design ensures safe trade when both parties delegate (execute_fair), and protects a delegating party from being exploited by a non-delegating party by canceling the trade if only one delegates. As a self-interested agent, I want to minimize my risk while enabling enforceable cooperation when mutual.

As a self-interested trader, I want guaranteed fair execution when both parties delegate (execute_fair) to avoid defection. If only one delegates, cancel protects the delegating party from being forced to deliver while the other could defect, minimizing risk.

This design ensures safe, fair trades when both parties delegate (preventing defection), but cancels if only one delegates to avoid being forced into a trade where the other party could defect. It protects self-interested traders who want optional security.
This design ensures safe, enforced execution when both parties delegate, protecting against defection. If only I delegate, cancellation prevents me from being exploited by a non-delegating defector.

As a self-interested trader, I want guaranteed fair exchange when both parties delegate (no defection risk). If only I delegate, I want the trade canceled to avoid being exploited if the other defects. This design maximizes my safety while allowing cooperative gains when mutual trust is established via mediator.

This design ensures guaranteed fair exchange when both parties delegate (reducing defection risk), but cancels trades when only one delegates to prevent exploitation of the delegating party. As a self-interested agent, this protects me while allowing secure trades.
